title: Automated Car Wash Business Feasibility Study: A Complete 2026 Guide
description: A feasibility study for an automated car wash business covering costs, profits, risks, and smart wash systems from WashThru, to help you make a well-informed investment decision.
coverImageAlt: An automated car wash facility illustrating an automated car wash business feasibility study
contentHtml:
Can an automated car wash business in 2026 really generate profits of up to SAR 50,000 a month? That's usually the first question on any investor's mind when they consider entering the car wash industry, especially with the growing adoption of automated wash systems and rising demand for fast, labor-light solutions.

In short, the answer depends on several factors: preparing an accurate car wash feasibility study, choosing the right location, the quality of your wash equipment, and having a clear understanding of the cost of an automatic car wash and the operating expenses tied to it.

Traditional wash stations, meanwhile, still struggle with challenges like high labor costs, inconsistent service quality, and wasted water and time. That's why more investors are turning to automated car washes as a more efficient, stable alternative, especially as automated wash systems keep improving productivity and reducing reliance on manual operation.

In this guide, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about an automated car wash business, from costs and profits to equipment types and the key success factors, drawing on WashThru's experience delivering complete solutions that help you launch your project on solid ground, backed by realistic numbers rather than guesswork.

First: Why You Need a Feasibility Study Before You Start

Any automated car wash business depends on daily operations, which means any mistake made early on can directly affect your profits.

That's why, at WashThru, we consider a feasibility study the essential first step before any investment decision.

A feasibility study helps you:

  • Understand the real costs (CapEx)
  • Forecast revenue realistically
  • Understand the right operating model
  • Reduce risk before launching the project
  • Choose the right wash system from WashThru's lineup

This article gives you the full picture you need to evaluate the project before making any operational commitment.

Second: Types of Automated Car Washes from WashThru

At WashThru, we offer a range of automated wash machines designed to suit different locations and investment levels. Choosing the right automatic car wash machine is the most important decision in an automated car wash business, since it determines:

  • Daily operating capacity
  • The size of the required investment
  • The quality of service delivered
  • The end customer experience

1. Rollover Car Wash (Rollover Wash)

WashThru's rollover automatic car wash is suited to small and medium spaces, and it's one of the best labor-free automatic car wash options for first-time investors.

Advantages:

  • Doesn't require a large footprint
  • Near-fully automatic operation through the WashThru app
  • A great starting point for a car wash investment
  • Wash time: 3.5 to 5 minutes
  • IPS technology: smart sensors that scan the vehicle's size precisely

2. Tunnel Car Wash (Tunnel Wash)

WashThru's tunnel automatic car wash is the solution for high-density locations, and it's among the most powerful automated wash systems in terms of throughput and return.

Advantages:

  • Very high throughput (one car every 1-2 minutes)
  • Suited to highways and busy commercial centers
  • The highest return on a car wash investment in high-traffic locations
  • AI-powered predictive maintenance: alerts before a breakdown occurs
  • API integration: easy integration with payment and ERP systems

3. Touchless Car Wash (Touchless Wash)

A touchless automatic car wash is an advanced WashThru technology that relies on high-pressure water combined with specialized cleaning agents to remove dirt without any direct contact with the vehicle.

Advantages:

  • Complete protection for the car's paint against scratches
  • Very well suited to new and luxury vehicles

Available models include the RF-V1 and the RCV-V1.

Third: Choosing the Right Location (The Most Important Success Factor)

Based on our extensive experience at WashThru, we always emphasize that the success of an automated car wash business starts with the location, before the equipment.

Key criteria:

  • High traffic density: a main road or a location with significant daily vehicle traffic.
  • Easy access: a clear entrance, sufficient waiting space, and a smooth exit for vehicles.
  • Proximity to complementary services: such as gas stations, malls, and maintenance centers, which increases the chances of attracting customers during their daily errands.

The golden rule: a strong location can double your profits even with average equipment.

Fourth: Expected Costs for an Automated Car Wash Business in 2026

The figures below are estimates that vary by location and the type of automatic car wash machine chosen, and they are used within an automated car wash feasibility study to assess a project's viability before implementation begins.

Capital expenditure (CapEx)

  • Site preparation: SAR 8,000 to 15,000.
  • Licensing: SAR 15,000 to 25,000.
  • Automatic car wash machine: determined based on the customer and the type of automated wash system chosen.

Operating costs (OpEx)

  • Rent: SAR 10,000 to 25,000 per month.
  • Salaries: SAR 12,000 to 18,000 per month.
  • Consumables: SAR 3,000 to 6,000 per month.
  • Electricity and water: SAR 4,000 to 7,000 per month.

Fifth: Expected Profits from an Automated Car Wash

Typical operations for a car wash business depend on choosing the right automatic car wash machine and a good location:

  • Wash price: SAR 30 to 50.
  • Number of cars: 50 to 100 cars per day.

Expected results:

  • Monthly revenue: SAR 50,000 to 100,000.
  • Net profit: SAR 20,000 to 50,000 per month.
  • Payback period: 12 to 30 months.

These figures vary depending on the project's location and the type of automatic car wash machine chosen, and they form part of a complete automated car wash business feasibility study.

Sixth: Can an Automated Car Wash Operate Without Labor?

The reality: no, but an automatic car wash machine significantly reduces reliance on labor compared to traditional wash stations.

You'll still need:

  • An operations supervisor
  • 1-3 staff to guide vehicles
  • Basic monitoring of the system

The advantage of an automated car wash business:

  • Consistent service quality
  • Fewer human errors
  • Simpler operation and management
  • Lower salary costs than a traditional car wash

Seventh: Risks and How to Avoid Them — Safety and Sustainability Standards

Any automated car wash business faces a set of operational challenges, but reducing risk starts with choosing the right automatic car wash machine and relying on smart safety and monitoring systems.

1. Operational breakdowns

WashThru's solution: relying on safety systems, smart sensors, and regular maintenance, alongside tracking faults and alerts through the Wash Cloud system, which automatically reports issues and helps reduce unexpected downtime.

2. Low customer turnout

The solution: choosing the right location, a clear entrance, and a proper marketing plan, because the success of an automated car wash feasibility study doesn't depend on the machine alone, but on daily traffic volume and how easily customers can reach it.

3. High operating costs

The solution: using water recycling systems and smart operation to raise efficiency and cut expenses, especially since some WashThru systems highlight water savings of up to 70%, an important factor in controlling a car wash's operating costs and improving sustainability.

4. Safety within the automated wash system

The solution: relying on an automatic car wash machine equipped with emergency-stop sensors and failsafe systems supported across WashThru's automated car wash equipment, since sensing and anti-collision systems are used in this industry to reduce accident risk and protect both the vehicle and the equipment during operation.

Eighth: Modern Marketing Strategy (Digital and Field Outreach)

Marketing is the engine that drives cars to your wash, and it's an essential part of a successful automated car wash feasibility study.

1. Digital marketing (via social media)

TikTok

  • The idea: create short "before and after" videos with a cinematic touch and visual challenges.
  • In practice: film a quick video showing WashThru's crystal-clear foam covering a very dirty car, set to upbeat music, which can help the content go viral.

Snapchat and Instagram

  • The idea: precise geographic targeting (geofencing).
  • In practice: an ad showing how easy payment and operation are through the WashThru app, targeting nearby residents with a special discount for mentioning the ad code or on their first visit.

2. Field marketing and loyalty programs

Subscription plans

  • The idea: turn a one-time customer into steady, guaranteed monthly revenue.
  • In practice: offer an "unlimited monthly wash" package at a promotional price (such as SAR 250), activated through automatic license-plate recognition without the customer having to wait.

Local partnerships

  • The idea: reach a large target audience through intermediary partners.

In practice: partner with delivery companies (such as HungerStation or Mrsool) or car rental agencies to offer preferential rates for washing their fleets on a regular basis.
